title: The heartbreaking story of Hakuji and Koyuki

cuts.voiceover_text: A desperate boy stole medicine to keep his dying father alive. Every single stolen vial brought brutal public beatings and dark criminal tattoo lines. But his sacrifice ended in total devastation when his father hanged himself to stop his son from committing crimes. Hakuji is completely shattered by grief. He clings to the suicide note in tears, screaming in helpless fury at the cruel world that stole his only reason to live.

Left with nothing but burning rage, Hakuji picked violent street fights with anyone in sight. That self-destructive spiral suddenly ends when a martial arts master named Keizo effortlessly catches his punch. Hakuji is stunned by his overwhelming strength. Instead of reporting the tattooed delinquent, Keizo takes him home to his dojo. He feeds the battered boy, offers him an honest purpose, and gives Hakuji a genuine second chance at life.

Inside the dojo, Keizo entrusts Hakuji with caring for his frail, bedridden daughter, Koyuki. Hakuji patiently tends to her bedside day and night, cooling her high fevers with damp towels. Koyuki is deeply touched by his gentle dedication. For the first time in years, Hakuji feels true purpose and inner peace. He quietly vows to always stay by her side and protect her fragile life at any cost.

Years later, Koyuki fully recovers from her illness and invites Hakuji to watch the dazzling summer fireworks together. Under the glowing night sky, Koyuki lovingly asks Hakuji to marry her and inherit the martial arts dojo. Hakuji is completely overwhelmed with emotion. Tears stream down his face as he realizes this hard-earned happiness is real. He passionately accepts her hand, swearing from the bottom of his heart to protect Koyuki with his life.

While Hakuji is away paying respects at his father's grave, jealous rival swordsmen secretly poison the dojo's drinking well. Hakuji returns home only to discover Keizo and Koyuki dead. That horrific sight completely shatters his soul. Consumed by blinding agony and fury, Hakuji storms the rival dojo all alone. He unleashes ferocious bare-handed strikes, brutally slaughtering sixty-seven armed swordsmen in an unstoppable, blood-soaked frenzy of raw vengeance.

Drenched in blood amid the carnage, Hakuji is confronted by the demon lord Muzan. Muzan pierces Hakuji's skull with his bare fingers, forcibly pumping demonic blood straight into his brain. Hakuji's humanity is violently ripped away as he transforms into the Upper Moon demon Akaza. His human memories vanish completely, leaving behind only a hollow, ruthless obsession to become strong.

Centuries later in his final battle, Akaza is beheaded, yet his headless body refuses to die. But as his demonic flesh tries to regenerate, forgotten human memories suddenly flood back into his mind. Akaza realizes the weakness he truly despised was his own failure to save Koyuki. Horrified by the monster he became, Akaza turns his devastating martial arts strikes inward, intentionally smashing his own body to pieces.

As his demonic body disintegrates into burning embers, the gentle spirit of Koyuki suddenly appears before him. She wraps her arms around Akaza in a warm, forgiving embrace. Hakuji's true human form returns as he breaks down in agonizing tears, begging for forgiveness. Koyuki softly smiles, holding him close with unconditional love. Free from his demonic curse at last, Hakuji finds eternal peace, walking hand in hand with her into the afterlife.
